user.title: Add light defaults
user.description: Defaults fill in brightness or color when a light turns on from off and the call leaves them out.

lights.title: Defaults for some lights
lights.description: Pick one or more lights to share these values. A light group also covers the lights in it, for any value they don't set themselves. Leave a value empty to use the one from a group these lights are in, or from the defaults for all lights.

data_description.entities: Lights already in another entry, excluded lights included, aren't listed.
data_description.name: Shown on the Light Defaults page. Leave empty to use the light names.
data_description.temperature: Color lights switch to white. Lights with neither color nor color temperature ignore this.
data_description.no_default: These lights keep their usual behavior for what you pick here, even if a group or the defaults for all lights set it. Overrides the value above.

all.title: Defaults for all lights
all.description: Used for any value a light's own entry, or a group it's in, leaves out. Excluded lights never get these.

data_description.temperature: Color lights switch to white. Lights with neither color nor color temperature ignore this.

exclude.title: Lights to exclude
exclude.description: These lights never get defaults, not even values set for them or for a group they're in. Picking a group excludes the lights in it.

data_description.entities: Lights already in another entry aren't listed.

error.already_configured: Some of these lights were just added to another entry.
error.no_defaults: Set a value, or pick one under No default for.
error.no_values: Set a brightness, a color temperature or both.

abort.already_configured: That's already set up. Use Configure on its entry to change it.
abort.already_in_progress: That's already being set up in another window.
